frozen_before_runner: This PREREG file commits before creating testing source or hosting new episodes
source_public: FullyObsWrapper pose, heading, goal, binary front blocked; wall vs ball type discarded for ALL learner arms; no .unwrapped or hidden map

native_selective: Original R3 unchanged. At each returned public observation, maintain per-edge history of blocked/clear, observation count, consecutive confirmations, and reversals; public-only. Observed blocked edges expire after 2 steps unless three consecutive confirmations with no reversal, in which case retain until a contradictory public reading. An edge observed to reverse receives a 1-step expiry; observed clear edges expire after 3 steps. Recompute R3's planning blocked/open edges from current effective evidence before native choose; actual action outcome uses original R3 observe. Store evidence and R3 snapshot in authenticated cold-persistent wrapper.
conventional_recent: Original independent conventional learned-motor planner, clearing prior edge beliefs each current planning step
conventional_ttl: Same independently fitted conventional learned-motor planner, retain blocked/open public edge observations only for 2 previously completed decision steps
conventional_probabilistic: Same independently fitted conventional learned-motor planner, per-edge Beta(1,1) beliefs with exponential discount 0.8 per step, blocked threshold >=0.60, clear threshold <=0.40, otherwise unknown; current public observation always updated first.
evidence: Every arm receives equal same twelve actual source FIT observations, actual own policies/interventions and only past public observations in that episode; no environment object class feature, fixed map, predicted future obstacle oracle or extra training.
criteria: Two independent whole-process original-source experiments per arm, byte-identical science, no original source identity drift
Compare native selective to native persistent and competent conventional recent TTL Bayesian controls on goals, source collisions, steps, original rewards in each original family
Native GO must not regress in either original static or dynamic family against trained conventional best practical comparable arm; otherwise NO-GO
Improved decisions must be based on observed changes not hidden wall/ball labels
Cold fresh OS process restores full native memory including selective belief state; CPU, peak RSS, checkpoint storage measured
No protected cohort first-use and no merge/admission on this public DEV result alone
controls: Stop on source drift, unsupported observations, dynamic collision semantics, unavailable runner, nondeterminism. Preserve all prior R1–R10 and C20-C22 negative and positive findings.
